notes: ἕνεκεν heads on sake as an improper preposition under rules 78 and 95, agreeing with Ἕνεκα → For this cause at 19:5; heading on for is the reading rule 78 reserves for a proper preposition.

πᾶς takes every one headed on every under rule 17's generic-noun clause, no article standing to claim the supplied noun. Reading one instead as the relative's supplied bare antecedent under rule 77 remains defensible, and rule 16 would have that named in the unit's own note.
